name: messaging-quest-agent
description: The strategist — Messaging Quest's brain, on Deep Agents. Optional: the engine, the dashboard, the cards and the extension all run without this directory being installed.
//: This package.json is deliberately NOT the root one. The heart (lib/, skills/, bin/) stays zero-dependency; the strategist carries the LangChain ecosystem, and lives behind one lazy import in bin/serve.mjs that degrades to a clear message when this directory has not been installed. `npm run brain` from the root installs it.
